title: Gray Tutorial: your client
description: What your JAM client reported: every test run, every program run, every step it took.

panels.title: Tests passed (last run)
panels.description: How many tests passed in the latest npm test.

targets.expr: gray_tutorial_tests_passed{client="$client"}

panels.title: Tests failed (last run)
panels.description: How many tests failed in the latest npm test.

targets.expr: gray_tutorial_tests_failed{client="$client"}

panels.title: JAM timeslot (last reported)
panels.description: The timeslot bin/now.ts reported last: six-second slots since the JAM Common Era.

targets.expr: gray_tutorial_slot{client="$client"}

panels.title: Test results
panels.description: Every test of every npm test run, newest first. Pick a run above to see only that one.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="test", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if eq .ok \"true\"}}pass{{else}}FAIL{{end}}  {{.name}}  ({{.file}}, {{.ms}} ms){{if .error}}  {{.error}}{{end}}"

panels.title: Decode trace
panels.description: What bin/decode.ts read, field by field: where each field's bytes start and end, and the bytes. Pick a decode run above.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="decode", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | step="decode" | line_format "{{.from}}..{{.to}}  {{.field}}  {{.bytes}}"

panels.title: Everything your client reported
panels.description: Every event, as the JSON line your client sent: the step, then its values.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", run_id=~"$run_id"}

panels.title: Chain
panels.description: What bin/chain.ts checked: each block's slot, its header hash, whether it names the block before as its parent, and whether its extrinsic matches its header's extrinsic hash.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="chain", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "slot {{.slot}}  {{.hash}}  linked: {{.linked}}  extrinsic matches: {{.matches}}"

panels.title: Assurances
panels.description: What bin/assurances.ts checked: each assurance's validator, whether the signature is that validator's, its Ed25519 key and its bitfield.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="assurances", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "validator {{.validator}}  signed: {{.signed}}  key {{.key}}  bitfield {{.bitfield}}"

panels.title: State trie
panels.description: What bin/state.ts built: each state entry's leaf (how deep in the trie, its value's size, and what it is, or its key), then the state root and whether the block's header promises the same.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="state", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | step="leaf" | line_format "depth {{.depth}}  {{.size}}-byte value  {{if .name}}{{.name}}{{else}}{{.key}}{{end}}"
{job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="state", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | step="root" | line_format "state root {{.root}}  the header promises it: {{.matches}}"

panels.title: Reading σ
panels.description: What bin/read-state.ts read from the state: τ (the time), η (four hashes of entropy) and κ (each validator's Ed25519 and Bandersnatch keys).

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="read-state", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if eq .step \"time\"}}τ: slot {{.slot}}{{else if eq .step \"entropy\"}}η{{.index}}: {{.hash}}{{else}}κ{{.index}}: ed25519 {{.ed25519}}  bandersnatch {{.bandersnatch}}{{end}}"

panels.title: Epochs
panels.description: What bin/epochs.ts saw: each block's slot, its epoch and its phase in the epoch, and, where a new epoch begins, whether the header carries an epoch mark.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="epochs", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "slot {{.slot}}  epoch {{.epoch}}  phase {{.phase}}{{if eq .newEpoch \"true\"}}  NEW EPOCH, epoch mark: {{.mark}}{{end}}"

panels.title: Shuffle
panels.description: What bin/shuffle.ts did: each pick (the number from the hash, mod how many are left, the index it lands on, the item picked), then the shuffled order.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="shuffle", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if eq .step \"pick\"}}{{.number}} mod {{.left}} = {{.index}}: pick {{.picked}}{{else}}shuffled: {{.order}}{{end}}"

panels.title: Entropy
panels.description: What bin/entropy.ts computed from a safrole vector: each of η's four hashes before and after the block, then whether a new epoch began and whether η′ matches the vector.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="entropy", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if eq .step \"eta\"}}η{{.index}}  {{.before}} → {{.after}}{{else}}slot {{.slot}}, new epoch: {{.newEpoch}}, η′ matches the vector: {{.matches}}{{end}}"

panels.title: Validator rotation
panels.description: What bin/rotation.ts computed from a safrole vector: each validator set before and after the block, every validator shown by the first four hex digits of its Ed25519 key (0000: an offender, zeroed).

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="rotation", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{.set}}  {{.before}}  →  {{.after}}"

panels.title: Sealers
panels.description: What bin/sealers.ts computed: for each slot of the new epoch, the fallback sealer's key and which validator of κ′ it belongs to, then whether all of them match the vector.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="sealers", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if eq .step \"sealer\"}}slot {{.phase}}: validator {{.validator}}  {{.key}}{{else}}the sealers match the vector: {{.matches}}{{end}}"

panels.title: Lottery
panels.description: What bin/lottery.ts found: whether the block closes a full ticket lottery, and if so the slot of the next epoch each winning ticket will seal (rank 0 is the best ticket).

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="lottery", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if eq .step \"seat\"}}slot {{.phase}}: ticket {{.rank}}  {{.id}}{{else}}slot {{.before}} → {{.after}}, tickets mark: {{.mark}}{{end}}"

panels.title: Safrole
panels.description: What bin/safrole.ts told about one block of Safrole: the slot, η₀ stirred, whether a new epoch began, the rotation, the sealers, the marks, and whether the whole state after matches the vector.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="safrole", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{.what}}"

panels.title: Belt
panels.description: What bin/belt.ts built: the mountain belt after each append (● a mountain, · an empty place, smallest first) and its super-peak.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="belt", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "after {{.items}}: {{.peaks}}  super-peak {{.superPeak}}"

panels.title: Recent history
panels.description: What bin/history.ts read from a real state: each remembered block (slot, header hash, state root, how many work-packages it reported), then the belt's peaks.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="history", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if eq .step \"block\"}}slot {{.slot}}  header {{.header_hash}}  state root {{.state_root}}  reported {{.reported}}{{else}}the belt: {{.peaks}}{{end}}"

panels.title: Verdicts
panels.description: What bin/verdicts.ts found: each verdict's report, how many votes say valid, which set judged (κ or λ), whether every vote is signed by its judge, and the outcome.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="verdicts", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "report {{.report}}: {{.valid}} of {{.votes}} valid, judged by {{.set}}, signed: {{.signed}}, {{.decided}}"

panels.title: Offenders
panels.description: What bin/offenders.ts found: each culprit (a guarantor of a bad report) and each fault (a vote against the verdict), with whether its signature is really theirs.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="offenders", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if eq .step \"culprit\"}}culprit {{.key}}: guaranteed {{.report}}, really theirs: {{.signed}}{{else}}fault {{.key}}: voted {{.said}} on {{.report}}, really theirs: {{.signed}}{{end}}"

panels.title: Cores
panels.description: What bin/cores.ts found: each core that loses its pending report because the report was judged bad or wonky, then how many cores keep theirs.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="cores", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if eq .step \"cleared\"}}core {{.core}}: report {{.report}} judged {{.verdict}}, off the core{{else}}{{.kept}} of {{.cores}} cores keep their reports{{end}}"

panels.title: Availability
panels.description: What bin/available.ts counted: for each core with a pending report, how many validators hold its data, and whether that's more than two thirds (available).

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="available", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "core {{.core}}: {{.assured}} of {{.validators}} hold its data, available: {{.available}}"

panels.title: Releases
panels.description: What bin/release.ts decided for each core's pending report: it became available, it timed out, it was cleared because the validator set resized, or it stays.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="release", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "core {{.core}} at slot {{.slot}} (waiting since {{.since}}): {{.fate}}"

panels.title: Guarantors
panels.description: What bin/guarantors.ts checked: for each guarantee, its core, the slot it was made at, which rotation's assignment it answers to, its signers, and whether they're all assigned to that core.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="guarantors", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "core {{.core}}, made at slot {{.made}} ({{.which}}): signers {{.signers}}, all assigned: {{.assigned}}"

panels.title: Reporters
panels.description: What bin/reporters.ts checked: each guarantee's signers (short keys) and whether every signature is real, then how many distinct reporters signed.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="reporters", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if eq .step \"guarantee\"}}core {{.core}}: signed by {{.signers}}, all real: {{.signed}}{{else}}reporters: {{.count}} keys from {{.signatures}} signatures{{end}}"

panels.title: Placed
panels.description: What bin/placed.ts did: each guaranteed report placed on its core (and whether the core was empty), then the packages the block reports, sorted by hash.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="placed", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if eq .step \"placed\"}}core {{.core}} ({{.was}}): package {{.package}} from slot {{.slot}}{{else}}reported: package {{.package}}, exports root {{.exports_root}}{{end}}"

panels.title: Authorizer pools
panels.description: What bin/pools.ts did: each core's authorizer pool before and after the block (each authorizer as its first 4 hex digits), the one that left and the one that joined from the queue.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="pools", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "core {{.core}}: {{.before}}  − {{.gone}}, + {{.joined}}  →  {{.after}}"

panels.title: Preimages
panels.description: What bin/preimages.ts did: each preimage in the block, given to the service that asked for it, with the request's history before and after.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="preimages", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "service {{.service}}: {{.bytes}} bytes, hash {{.hash}}  request {{.was}} → {{.now}}"

panels.title: Service
panels.description: What bin/service.ts read about a service from a real state: who created it, its code, its footprint, its balance and the minimum it must keep.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="service", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{.line}}"

panels.title: Program
panels.description: What bin/program.ts unpacked from a service's code: the preimage's layers (metadata, standard program, PVM blob) and the blob's jump table, code and bitmask.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="program", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{.line}}"

panels.title: Disassembly
panels.description: What bin/disassemble.ts decoded: each instruction's place in the code, its name, registers, immediates and jump target.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="disassemble", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{.at}}  {{.text}}"

panels.title: PVM run
panels.description: What bin/run.ts executed: each step's number, the instruction counter, the instruction, the registers it changed, and how the step ended.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="run", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "step {{.n}} at {{.at}}: {{.name}}  {{.changed}}  ({{.exit}})"

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: What bin/memory.ts did: a page's bytes before and after a store, the values loaded back, and a fault on a page that isn't there.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="memory", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{.line}}"

panels.title: ALU
panels.description: What bin/alu.ts computed: the arithmetic edge cases the Gray Paper spells out, each instruction with its answer in hex and as a signed number.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="alu", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{.name}}  {{.what}}  {{.answer}}"

panels.title: Branches
panels.description: What bin/branches.ts ran: every branch with r0 = −1 against 1, and whether it jumped. Unsigned, −1 is the biggest number there is; signed, it's less than 1.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="branches", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{.name}}  taken: {{.taken}}"

panels.title: Bits
panels.description: What bin/bits.ts ran: the ten bit-and-byte instructions on one number, each answer in hex and as a signed number.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="bits", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{.name}}({{.x}})  {{.answer}}"

panels.title: A real program starts
panels.description: What bin/start.ts did: the bootstrap service's memory as Y lays it out, its starting registers, every step from accumulation's entry point, and the host call it stops at.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="start", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{.line}}"

panels.title: Costs
panels.description: What bin/costs.ts listed: each instruction of a real basic block with its row from the Gray Paper's cost table: cycles, decode slots and execution units.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="costs", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{.at}}  {{.name}}  cycles {{.cycles}}  slots {{.slots}}  {{.units}}"

panels.title: Pipeline
panels.description: What bin/pipeline.ts drew: a real basic block's reorder buffer, cycle by cycle (W waiting, E executing, F finished, . retired), and the gas the block costs.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="pipeline", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if .row}}cycle {{.cycle}}  {{.row}}{{else}}block {{.block}} costs {{.cost}} gas{{end}}"

panels.title: Gas
panels.description: What bin/gas.ts ran: the bootstrap service with a gas budget, each basic block it paid for on the way in, and where it stopped: at its first host call, or out of gas.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="gas", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "budget {{.budget}}: {{if .exit}}stops {{.exit}} having spent {{.spent}}{{else}}block at {{.at}} costs {{.paid}}{{end}}"

panels.title: Host calls
panels.description: What bin/host.ts saw: every host call a real service made during accumulation, the answer it got in ω₇, the gas left, the transfers it sent, and how the service stopped.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="host", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if eq .step \"sent\"}}sent {{.amount}} to service {{.dest}}, with {{.gas}} gas, memo {{.memo}}{{else if .name}}host call {{.call}} ({{.name}}): {{.said}}, {{.gas}} gas left{{else}}stops {{.exit}}, using {{.used}} gas{{end}}"

panels.title: Accumulate
panels.description: What bin/accumulate.ts did: a test vector's block accumulated, which packages went and how many reports still wait, then each service's digests, transfers received and gas next to the vector's.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="accumulate", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if .slot}}slot {{.slot}}: accumulated {{.went}}; {{.waiting}} still waiting{{else}}service {{.s}}: {{.count}} digest(s), {{.transfers}} transfer(s), used {{.used}} (vector: {{.expected}}){{end}}"

panels.title: Validator statistics
panels.description: What bin/statistics.ts did: each validator's tally (blocks, tickets, preimages, preimage bytes, guarantees, assurances) before and after one block.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="statistics", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "validator {{.i}}: {{.before}} -> {{.after}}{{if eq .epoch_turned \"true\"}} (new epoch){{end}}"

panels.title: Core and service activity
panels.description: What bin/activity.ts did: one block's tallies for each core (data load, popularity, the work it took on) and each service (its share of that work), the fields that aren't zero.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="activity", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{.who}}: {{.did}}"
